title: Zesty Silky Turkish Flour Kebabs
description: Sweet, silky flat‑bread kebabs made with plain flour, citrus zest, and grilled on a robata grill for a light Turkish dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, vanilla, orange zest, and salt.
Add milk, melted butter, and lemon juice; stir until a soft dough forms.
Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead for 2 minutes until smooth.
Roll the dough into a rectangle about 1cm thick.
Preheat the robata grill to 200°C and oil the grill grate lightly.
Place the rolled dough on the grill, cooking for 4 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer the cooked dough to a cutting board and slice into kebab‑sized pieces.
Serve warm with a drizzle of honey if desired and a sprinkle of powdered sugar.
